text: The program admits candidates in the following areas: Clinical medical skills, training and research When you apply online, please fill in the research areas you would like to study. Application Time Before Dec. 24 Admission Review International Students office will first check the applicants, and then after first review, the departments of the major you applied will reexamine and will send second-round examination notice before March 20. The admission list will be published at the end of May. The university will send Admission Notice and JW202 at the end of June.
